meta.label: 2017 development test period (fit period 2017-04-26 to 2017-08-27; Black Friday week excluded)

nfr_021.target: recall >= 0.80 on faults with relative magnitude >= 20%, <= 2 false alarms per 30 days

recall_definitions.lenient: fault-caused alert on an affected KPI, any monitored series, from the first affected day to 7 days after the fault ends (the Phase 3 definition)
recall_definitions.strict: fault-caused alert on an affected KPI, on the targeted segment's own series (total for faults not aimed at a monitored dimension), within 3 days of the first affected day

nfr_021.why: the baseline and the README were measured with the lenient definition; a like-for-like comparison needs the same one. Strict is shown beside it as the more demanding reading.
